% eqnav.nvim -- all symbols, LaTeX edition.
%
% This file's job is the code paths all-symbols.md structurally cannot reach:
%
%   1. Both LaTeX scanners. With the `latex` treesitter parser (`make parsers`)
%      a .tex buffer uses queries/latex/eqnav.scm; without it, the regex
%      scanner (lua/eqnav/scan/regex.lua). tests/scan_spec.lua scans this file
%      both ways and requires the two to agree entry for entry.
%   2. \[..\] and \(..\) which are not markdown math and are skipped there.
%   3. Bare \begin{align} etc, which in markdown must be wrapped in $$..$$.
%   4. Preamble macro extraction -- render.preamble() in lua/eqnav/render/init.lua
%      returns nil for any filetype that is not tex/latex/plaintex, so this is
%      the only fixture that exercises it.
%   5. \section{} headings, the other branch of util.context().
%
% The equation count here will NOT match all-symbols.md, and should not: the
% two files cover different delimiter sets on purpose.
%
% KNOWN FINDINGS (2026-09-13): none. Everything in this file renders, and the
% three sections nesting split/cases/dcases inside an equation produce one
% entry each. Record anything new here as it is found, and delete the note as
% it is fixed.
%
% Fixed since this fixture was written: #9 (those nested environments were
% indexed twice, because lua/eqnav/scan/regex.lua filled its `consumed` table
% in the environment loop but only checked it in the delimiter loop below),
% #10 (every environment error-boxed on "Erroneous nesting of equation
% structures", because the daemon coloured by wrapping the source in
% \color{...}{...}) and #8 (\mathbb, \mathfrak and friends, whose glyphs live
% in font ranges MathJax only loads through the promise API).

\documentclass{article}

% Junk MathJax cannot execute. The daemon feeds the preamble one line at a time
% and swallows per-line failures (applyPreamble in scripts/mathjax-daemon.mjs),
% so these must not take the macro definitions below down with them.
\RequirePackage{amsmath}
\usepackage{amssymb,mathtools,physics}
\makeatletter
\def\@internalthing{nonsense}
\makeatother

% These three are what render.preamble() looks for. Every equation in section
% "Preamble macros" below depends on them; if that section renders as red
% undefined-macro text, preamble extraction is broken.
\newcommand{\Reals}{\mathbb{R}}
\newcommand{\vect}[1]{\mathbf{#1}}
\newcommand{\inner}[2]{\langle #1, #2 \rangle}
\renewcommand{\vec}[1]{\overrightarrow{#1}}
\DeclareMathOperator{\sgn}{sgn}
\DeclareMathOperator*{\argmin}{arg\,min}

\begin{document}

\section{Delimiters}

All four pairs are indexed by the regex scanner, unlike in markdown.

\[
  \text{(a) bracket form} \quad E = mc^2
\]

$$
\text{(b) dollar-dollar} \quad \nabla \times \vect{B} = \mu_0 \vect{J}
$$

Inline paren \( \text{(c) paren form} \quad a^2 + b^2 = c^2 \) mid-sentence.

Inline dollars $\text{(d) inline} \quad e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$ mid-sentence.

\section{Preamble macros}

Every equation here uses a macro defined above \verb|\begin{document}|.

\begin{equation}
  f : \Reals^n \to \Reals, \qquad \vect{x} \mapsto \inner{\vect{x}}{\vect{x}}
\end{equation}

\begin{equation}
  \sgn(x) = \frac{x}{\abs{x}}, \qquad \argmin_{\theta} \; L(\theta)
\end{equation}

\begin{equation}
  \vec{AB} \cdot \vec{CD} = \norm{\vec{AB}} \, \norm{\vec{CD}} \cos\theta
\end{equation}

\section{Environments}

\begin{equation}
  x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}
\end{equation}

\begin{equation*}
  \oint_{\partial \Sigma} \vect{B} \cdot d\boldsymbol{\ell} = \mu_0 I
\end{equation*}

\begin{align}
  a &= b + c \\
  d &= e + f
\end{align}

\begin{align*}
  \sin^2\theta + \cos^2\theta &= 1 \\
  \tan\theta &= \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}
\end{align*}

\begin{alignat}{2}
  x &= 1 &\quad y &= 2 \\
  z &= 3 &\quad w &= 4
\end{alignat}

\begin{gather}
  p = q \\
  r = s + t
\end{gather}

\begin{multline}
  a + b + c + d \\
  + e + f + g
\end{multline}

\begin{flalign}
  u &= v & w &= x
\end{flalign}

\begin{eqnarray}
  \alpha & = & \beta + \gamma \\
  \delta & = & \epsilon
\end{eqnarray}

\begin{displaymath}
  \sum_{k=1}^{n} k = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}
\end{displaymath}

\begin{equation}
  \begin{split}
    h &= i + j \\
      &= k
  \end{split}
\end{equation}

\begin{equation}
  f(x) = \begin{cases}
    x^2  & x \geq 0 \\
    -x^2 & x < 0
  \end{cases}
\end{equation}

\begin{equation}
  g(x) = \begin{dcases}
    \int_0^x t \, dt & x > 0 \\
    0                & \text{otherwise}
  \end{dcases}
\end{equation}

\section{Labels}

\begin{equation}
  E = mc^2 \label{eq:mass-energy}
\end{equation}

\section{Greek}

\[ \alpha \; \beta \; \gamma \; \delta \; \epsilon \; \zeta \; \eta \; \theta \; \iota \; \kappa \; \lambda \; \mu \]

\[ \nu \; \xi \; o \; \pi \; \rho \; \sigma \; \tau \; \upsilon \; \phi \; \chi \; \psi \; \omega \]

\[ \Gamma \; \Delta \; \Theta \; \Lambda \; \Xi \; \Pi \; \Sigma \; \Upsilon \; \Phi \; \Psi \; \Omega \]

\[ \varepsilon \; \vartheta \; \varpi \; \varrho \; \varsigma \; \varphi \; \digamma \]

\section{Operators and relations}

\[ \pm \; \mp \; \times \; \ast \; \star \; \circ \; \bullet \; \cdot \; \oplus \; \otimes \; \odot \; \uplus \; \sqcap \; \sqcup \]

\[ \leq \; \geq \; \equiv \; \sim \; \simeq \; \approx \; \cong \; \neq \; \prec \; \succ \; \ll \; \gg \; \subset \; \supseteq \; \in \]

\[ \nless \; \ngeq \; \nsim \; \ncong \; \nsubseteq \; \notin \; \nmid \; \nparallel \; \nvdash \]

\section{Arrows}

\[ \leftarrow \; \rightarrow \; \leftrightarrow \; \Leftarrow \; \Rightarrow \; \Leftrightarrow \; \mapsto \; \longmapsto \]

\[ \hookleftarrow \; \hookrightarrow \; \rightleftharpoons \; \uparrow \; \downarrow \; \nearrow \; \searrow \; \leadsto \]

\[ A \xrightarrow{\;f\;} B \xleftarrow{\;g\;} C \]

\section{Big operators}

\[ \sum_{k=1}^{n} k \qquad \prod_{i=1}^{m} a_i \qquad \int_a^b f(x)\,dx \qquad \oint_C \vect{F} \cdot d\vect{r} \qquad \iint_D \qquad \iiint_V \]

\[ \bigcup_{n} A_n \qquad \bigcap_{n} B_n \qquad \bigoplus_{i} V_i \qquad \bigotimes_{i} W_i \qquad \lim_{x \to 0} \qquad \limsup_{n} \]

\section{Fonts}

\[ \mathbb{ABCNQRZ} \qquad \mathcal{ABCLMX} \qquad \mathfrak{ABCgpq} \]

\[ \mathsf{ABCxyz} \qquad \mathtt{ABCxyz} \qquad \mathrm{ABCxyz} \qquad \mathbf{ABCxyz} \qquad \boldsymbol{\alpha\beta\gamma} \]

\section{Structures}

\[ \frac{a}{b} \quad \dfrac{a}{b} \quad \tfrac{a}{b} \quad \binom{n}{k} \quad \sqrt{x} \quad \sqrt[3]{y} \quad \cfrac{1}{1 + \cfrac{1}{1 + x}} \]

\[
  \vect{M} = \begin{pmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{pmatrix}
  \quad
  \begin{bmatrix} e & f \\ g & h \end{bmatrix}
  \quad
  \begin{vmatrix} i & j \\ k & l \end{vmatrix}
\]

\[ \hat{a} \; \tilde{a} \; \bar{a} \; \dot{a} \; \ddot{a} \; \widehat{abc} \; \overline{abc} \; \overbrace{a+b}^{u} \; \underbrace{c+d}_{v} \]

\section{Package spot-checks}

\[ \dv{f}{x} \quad \pdv{f}{x} \quad \bra{\psi} \quad \ket{\phi} \quad \braket{\psi}{\phi} \quad \comm{A}{B} \]

\[ \cancel{x} \quad \bcancel{y} \quad \cancelto{0}{z} \quad a \coloneqq b \quad \enclose{circle}{c} \quad \bbox[5px, border: 1px solid]{d} \]

\[ \begin{CD} A @>f>> B \\ @VgVV @VVhV \\ C @>k>> D \end{CD} \]

\section{The XML escaping landmine}

\[ a < b \]

\[ \text{if } x < y \text{ then } z > w \]

\[ A \xrightarrow{a<b} B \]

\section{Must NOT be indexed}

% $$ this commented equation must never appear in the index $$
% \begin{align} neither & = this \end{align}

A bare price of \$5 and another of \$7 in prose.

\begin{verbatim}
Not math, though the regex scanner cannot see verbatim the way treesitter
sees a fenced block -- this is the known limitation the README calls out.
\end{verbatim}

\end{document}
